thread:
rachel: Hi team — finalizing adoption placement next month. Planning to take 12 weeks parental leave starting the placement date. What paperwork differs from a birth, and how do I ensure benefits and pay start on day one?

diego: Congrats, rachel! :party: For adoption you don't file STD for a pregnancy, but we do need placement paperwork and court/adoption agency docs. Submit the parental leave request in the portal with "adoption" selected and upload placement papers. If you want job protection, file the FMLA/CFRA cert (if eligible).

maya: Payroll note: company top-up applies to adoptive primary caregivers the same as for birth (8 weeks at 100% base pay). To make sure top-up lands in the first pay after placement, get the portal request + placement docs submitted at least 10 business days before payroll cutoff. Cutoff is the 1st of the month for that month's payroll.

rachel: Good to know. Do I need an APR/attestation form too?

diego: Yes, for adoption we ask for either the agency placement letter or court documentation plus a signed company attestation form (we'll DM it). Also add the child to benefits within 30 days of placement to avoid gaps.

tom: Ops coverage: rachel, please add a short runbook with a 48-hour on-call triage and who to contact. Small example below you can copy into your doc:

```
oncall:
  primary: pagerduty-eng
  backup: diego
  steps: check service -> restart pod -> notify eng-sre
  docs: links to runbooks
```

rachel: Uploaded placement letter and the signed attestation to the portal. Drafted a 1-page handoff and added alerts.

payroll: AUTOMATED: "Parental leave request received for rachel (thread 1721506789). Please ensure placement docs and signed adoption attestation are uploaded to complete processing."

maya: I'll queue the top-up and confirm payment schedule once docs are validated. If anything is missing we'll reach out. Congrats again!

diego: If you want help with a contractor req for the first 8 weeks, ping me and I'll route to vendor bench.

rachel: Thanks everyone — really appreciate the support :)
